SSD.note: The deck names inadequate capacity to generate administrative records but states no work under way, no publication and no absence.
The deck says the Bureau is planning the first census and is executing new household surveys, with no mapping, funding, date or published results.
A statistics repository is only being developed; no published downloadable data is stated.
Only the African Charter on Statistics is named, which is not digital law.

facts.fact: The Director General of South Sudan's National Bureau of Statistics says the National Parliament recently passed the National Statistics Bill (year left blank), legally grounding the Bureau's mandate; nothing says it was promulgated.

The Director General of South Sudan's National Bureau of Statistics says the second National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS II) is being developed, covering the Bureau and other producers of official statistics.
